subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should OpenCode and Pi session discovery activate automatically and remain enabled by default for existing installations once the Pi trust boundary is corrected?
rationale: This changes startup activation and default discovery of local and paired-node session history; tests cannot determine whether that upgrade behavior matches the intended privacy and product policy.

options.title: Approve default-on discovery
options.body: Keep both catalogs enabled by default after fixing Pi trust/path handling and proving the exact final head on fresh and upgraded configurations.

options.title: Make discovery opt-in
options.body: Default both catalog settings off so existing installations do not begin session-history discovery until an operator enables it.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the linked issue and PR open without landing until maintainers settle the session-discovery privacy and upgrade policy.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on discovery
recommendation.body: Keep both catalogs enabled by default after fixing Pi trust/path handling and proving the exact final head on fresh and upgraded configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this person as the sponsor of the linked product request and author of its proposed boundary, although current-main ownership history could not be independently inspected.
